setup: Existing elevated native setup; no provisioning command or manual account, ACL, firewall, or user-config change performed by these probes.

filesystem_probe.command_shape: codex sandbox -P qualia-operator -C <synthetic-project> -c windows.sandbox="elevated" <explicit profile overrides> -- python <synthetic probe>
